## About

I am interested in political behavior and elections, especially the trend of conservatism in Generation Z voters. My previous research focused on the effects of affirmative action policies on campus demographics and the impacts of Medicaid budget cuts on voter turnout. 


## Teaching

**Teaching Assistant**

- U.S. Government: Congress, President, & Courts and The Supreme Court, Department of Political Science, University of Houston, August 2025 to May 2026

**Tutoring and Supplemental Instruction**

- Group Tutor, Elementary Statistical Modeling, University of Houston, Fall 2024 to Spring 2025
- CRLA Level III Certified Tutor, College Reading and Learning Association, Fall 2024

## Working Papers

- Le, Jacqueline, and CJ Sheick. 2026. “Is Gen Z the Most Conservative Generation of Our Time? The Rise of Conservatism and Voting Behavior from 2008 to 2024 by the Generations.”
